description: This file implements a retry mechanism with configurable backoff strategies, timers, and notification callbacks. It provides a Retry function that attempts an operation repeatedly until success, a permanent error, or timeout, with support for context cancellation.

methods.name: WithBackOff
methods.description: Configures a custom backoff strategy for retries.

methods.name: withTimer
methods.description: Sets a custom timer for managing retry delays.

methods.name: WithNotify
methods.description: Sets a notification callback for retry errors.

methods.name: WithMaxTries
methods.description: Limits the maximum number of retry attempts.

methods.name: WithMaxElapsedTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum total duration for retries.

methods.name: Retry
methods.description: Attempts an operation repeatedly with backoff until success, permanent error, or timeout, supporting context cancellation.
